about: This consists primarily of exclusive live material, presented and recorded on the Northern Excavation Tour during 2025 and subsequent performances in 2026 only.
credits:
Released by Yantra Atmospheres, YA-2026-115. 

Music, mastering and sleeve design by Peter Andersson. 
Images from the work of Thomas Stothard and Gustave Doré. 

Covering almost 3 hours of music. High quality recordings tapped directly from stage mixer. 

The triple-CD comes in 6-panel extra heavy cardboard digisleeve printed on reverse board. 

The digital download album is available in 24-bit/44.1kHz quality. 

Track 1-10 / CD1: 
Recordings from the Northern Excavation Tour 2025 
Track 1, 3-6 MS Stubnitz/Hamburg/Germany Oct 7 
Track 2 Voodoo Club/Warsaw/Poland Sep 24 
Track 7 Slaughterhouse/Berlin/Germany Sep 26 
Track 8 Hus 7/Stockholm/Sweden Sep 17 
Track 9 Nirvana/Turku/Finland Sep 19 
and Ambientalika V/KIC/Zagreb/Croatia Apr 11, 2026 
Track 10 Black Temple/Athens/Greece Jan 24, 2026 

Track 11-23 / CD2: 
Recording from a private performance 
at The Alte Feuerwache Loschwitz, Dresden, Germany. 
August 2, 2025. 

Track 24-32 / CD3: 
Recording from Rituals Over Limburg III Festival 
at Nieuwe Nor, Heerlen, The Netherlands. 
November 8, 2025.
